authority: Selected maintainer replay rules from guide section 13 and WP07-S04, subject to recorded user amendments; no extra user directions or actual release claim.

identity.optionalThirdPartyIntegrations: Separate registered identities and retained binaries, when actually published.

history.membershipSource: Trusted append-only actual-publication ledger, never candidate APIs/TFMs or latest/stable selection.
history.newIdentityWithNoBaseline: Record NoBaselineForIdentity; qualify its first-publication controls while replaying every applicable existing identity.

layers.name: Package and API
required: Iterate each historical package/contract identity and every published target/RID asset; missing candidate assets fail rather than reduce applicability.
Compare exact retained baseline to exact candidate with pinned APICompat/package validation in compatibility mode; additive surface is permitted only when supported old usage is preserved.

Explicitly enable supported parameter-name and relevant attribute rules; independently inspect published names, optional defaults, constants/enums, nullable/construction/interface/layout and assembly identity guarantees that tooling does not cover.
Preserve package target/minimum-runtime and approved dependency-closure contracts. Current C# Core has one assembly including the provider.
No baseline-TFM ignore, rebuilt baseline or real-break suppression; a tool false positive requires narrow tool/source-bound disposition plus independent historical regression.
Keep native invocation/report/tool hashes and baseline/candidate identity for every comparison; one PackageValidationBaselineVersion is not cumulative history.

layers.name: Historical source compilation and execution
required: Hash-verify and copy preserved source/settings into an owned workspace; never edit archives, historical lockfiles, source calls or expectations.
Substitute only requested CisLib package versions and necessary permitted dependency closure in the workspace; retain a substitution manifest and project/restore diff.
Preserve original contract TFM, RID where declared, language version, nullable, warning-as-error and compilation settings; no suppressions or implicit retargeting.
Regenerate a temporary lockfile only for the substituted workspace; restore exact staged candidate bytes from isolated sources/caches and record resolved assets/closure.
Compile original constructors, named arguments, null, extension/overload/conversion and supported public-interface consumer patterns; warnings-as-errors remains active.
Execute the compiled consumer and compare its frozen behavior expectations; compiler exit zero alone is insufficient.
Historical SDK/target/runtime execution is separate from supplementary current-toolchain/current-runtime execution; missing archived prerequisites refuse required qualification.

layers.name: Unchanged binary replay
required: Copy frozen consumer DLL and any retained PDB and runtime/dependency material into an isolated workspace; verify original consumer hashes before/after and never compile, instrument or rewrite that consumer.
Execute CoreReplacement and CompleteUpgrade independently for every applicable retained consumer; use old optional integrations in replacement and candidate integrations in complete upgrade.
MicrosoftLogger is replaced with its containing CIS.Core DLL in both scenarios; when Core is the only library identity, retain separate scenario evidence even if their payloads match.
Keep unaffected dependencies frozen and materialize only the necessary permitted closure changes; record dependency-manifest/probing/runtime-host adaptations outside immutable storage.
Prove actual loaded candidate Core/integration/dependency paths, assembly metadata and SHA-256 from the consumer process; restoration or a copied DLL alone is not proof.
Keep original-runtime replay and explicitly selected current-runtime replay distinct; record actual runtime/OS/architecture and any test-only roll-forward override.
Compare frozen behavior and prove every required scenario/target/lane executed; missing material, fallback to old Core or an unexpected skip cannot pass.

layers.name: Configuration, wire and documented behavior
required: Execute all accumulated historical configuration, event, error and behavioral fixtures against the exact candidate; new expectations cannot replace old ones.
Compare defaults/aliases/precedence/blank-invalid/bounds and one-time paths; preserve immutable metadata, error types/codes, ownership, sync/async and cancellation meanings.
Compare stream separation, enabled/filtered/lazy admission, scope flow/precedence, bounded projection/truncation, per-output ordering/failure and fixed-boundary loss/accounting.
Preserve JSON schema selection, required/known optional presence, null vs omission, value kinds/precision, UTC/UUID forms, framing/encoding and unknown-optional reader policy.
Compare human information availability/stream/bounds guarantees independently from permitted presentation changes; never trim captured message/attribute text to hide differences.
Apply only baseline-authorized named normalization rules after validating raw data and cross-record invariants; never apply a generic ignore list or reorder delivered records.
Retain raw and compared observations, named transformations/predicate checks, candidate load proof and per-fixture outcomes.

allowedWorkspaceChanges: Selected CisLib PackageReference version values or equivalent generated version overrides
Temporary restored lockfile and probing/source configuration
requiredProof: Original source/settings hashes before and after
Exact package substitution map and workspace diff
Native compiler result and executed consumer behavior

binaryScenarios.optionalIntegrations: Frozen historical optional integration DLLs where present
binaryScenarios.dependencies: Preserve unaffected historical artifacts; record only permitted closure changes required for candidate Core.

binaryScenarios.optionalIntegrations: Exact candidate versions for every applicable published optional integration identity
binaryScenarios.dependencies: Resolved approved candidate closure; record every materialized path/hash.

runtimeScenarios.selection: Exact retained original runtime/SDK materialization; record test-only Disable roll-forward override for the replay host, without editing archived runtimeconfig.
Explicit supported runtime and recorded host roll-forward; preserve original binary/target/config archives. Supplementary evidence cannot replace original-runtime evidence.

normalization.default: Exact documented semantic comparison; deterministic inputs stay exact. No transformation applies by default.
normalization.authorization: A frozen fixture must select a rule by ID and scope. Validate raw shape/format, availability and invariants before canonicalizing only named generated values.
normalization.wireObjectMemberOrder: Not a contract; compare parsed objects structurally, preserving array/stream order and all known fields.
normalization.unknownOptionalFields: Only the historical reader policy permits additive unknown fields; preserve known field meaning and producer projection guarantees.

rules.action: Bind generated lowercase D UUID to a run-local token after verifying format, stable snapshot/event identity and independent-process uniqueness. Never normalize a supplied UUID attribute.

Bind explicitly generated instants only after validating seven-digit UTC form, actual process-start vs initialization distinction, snapshot immutability and fixture-defined clock/deadline relations. Injected deterministic instants remain exact.

Compare optional availability and actual independently observed child/process/runtime metadata under the fixture capture policy, then bind only verified environment-specific values. Never normalize service/env/version/build IDs, os_family, architectures or environment_kind.

Only a fixture-declared owned workspace root alias may vary. Assert absolute path, exact suffix, containment and once-only resolution before binding the root. Literal paths and wrong-directory resolution remain failures; do not rewrite frozen source/inputs.

forbidden: Normalizing missing fields or invalid forms
Changing number/string/null types or decimal-string precision
Erasing severities, names, messages, operation/trace/span IDs, user attributes, errors, counters or truncation markers
Sorting event streams/arrays or collapsing independent output outcomes
Changing timeouts, completion/success/loss, cancellation, ownership or validation order

zeroHistory.globalCondition: Trusted complete ledger.publications.Count == 0, not no stable releases or no remaining candidate targets.
requiredFirstReleaseWork: Qualify all four harness layers with positive and deliberately incompatible controls
Compile supported candidate source consumer patterns under declared settings
Freeze and replay candidate-built binary consumers without recompilation
Execute schema/configuration/behavior fixtures and both binary/runtime scenarios where applicable
Prove exact candidate loads and required platform coverage
Retain consumer source/settings/binaries/dependencies/toolchains and complete verification kit
Append immutable first baseline only after actual package exposure
zeroHistory.afterAnyPrerelease: Empty-history exception ends immediately for subsequent candidates, including first stable.

evidence.notApplicable: Only fixture-declared scope that was not promised by that historical contract; retain explicit reason and matrix row. Candidate omissions cannot change applicability.
